newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian Nestle up 5 pct on results.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian Nestle up 5 pct on results.

text.p: First half results for Nestle Foods Nigeria were well received by traders on Monday and shares rose the maximum five percent allowed in one day.
After tax profits in the six months to June rose to 287 million naira from 171 million naira the year before, 68 percent higher.
Turnover grew by 44 percent to 2.6 billion naira against 1.8 billion naira, and profit before tax was 435 million naira against 293 million.
Shares closed up 1.45 naira at 30.50 naira on Monday.
"With so many companies showing profits decreasing relative to turnover it is good to see a company where profits have outpaced it," one trader said.
Nestle is currently engaged in an aggressive sales drive to promote its products -- Maggi seasonings, noodles, cereals and Milo food drink.
"Sales have progressed quite well," the company added.

However because of the addition of new shares following the merger with former associate company Nestle Nigeria Ltd. some brokers expressed reservation at the company's profit outlook despite the improved result.
"The price to earnings ratio will fall in view of its new shareholding structure," one said.
Nestle S.A. of Switzerland owns at least 40 percent shares in the company.
